in_sanskrit.name: Bivash
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mind, intellect
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bivash एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bivash is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘buddhi’, which means intellect or mind. The name is dedicated to the lord of the mind, symbolizing deep wisdom and understanding. This name is believed to bestow the gift of a sharp intellect and a strong willpower on the bearer.
